items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Clifford came by and played. I had Billy Wallace with me... He invited Clifford by. Clifford came by and just knocked everybody out.

ctx.x: Bird signed it off. When Bird died, the music lost all its enthusiasm. See, first Clifford Brown died in this automobile accident thing, he and Bud Powell’s brother. They came by my set, which is so weird.
